name: SchoolxSchool
source:
Main character is an ordinary high school student living his life casually surrounded by a colorful cast of unique personality friends. The summer sports festival on the sea approaches triggering a complex net of emotions and rivalry.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名普普通通的高中生，身边围绕着一群个性鲜明的朋友，过着随性自在的日子。
夏日海边运动会将至，错综复杂的情感与竞争也由此拉开序幕。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
